description: SvSwitchButton in a Svelte 5 settings panel: a list of labelled rows with descriptions, on and off labels on the track and a disabled row. Each switch is controlled through checked and onChange and writes into a settings object, and the panel is styled from the theme tokens.

faq.question: How do I label a switch?
faq.answer: Wrap it in a labelled row as the demo does, or pass ariaLabel when the visual label is elsewhere. The switch exposes the switch role with aria-checked.

faq.question: Can the track show on and off text?
faq.answer: Yes. The track labels are a prop, so a switch can read Yes and No or On and Off inside the control.

faq.question: How is a disabled switch handled?
faq.answer: disabled greys the control, removes it from the tab order and ignores clicks, while still showing its current state.
